name: agent-suite-persona-rationale
body: The distributed-versus-generated agent-roster boundary falls outside the existing owners: `requirements.user.navigator-agent` covers the task cadence under the branch graph's staleness guard, `requirements.user.code-writer-agent` covers filesystem grants, and the existing stakeholders cover source decomposition, frontend toolchains, the edge vocabulary, and checkout-independent graphs. `requirements.stakeholder.agent-suite-maintainer` owns the distribution boundary and `requirements.user.apg-upgrader` is the person who manually removes a duplicated local reviewer after `apg init`.
